a variant of MRPS28 gene (kDec03) is differentially expressed after radiation exposure in a cervical carcinoma cell line SiHa.
the variant of mitochondrial ribosomal s28 (mrsp28) gene is upregulated after radiation treatment in SiHa cell line.
a splice variant of mitochondrial ribosomal gene MRPS28 is differentially expressed by a cervical carcinoma cell line in response to radiation.

identification of genes that are differentially expressed in a cervical cancer cell line in response to radiation.
the study of differential gene expression in a cervical carcinoma cell line SiHa before and after radiation exposure.
the identification and characterization of genes that are differentially expressed in cervical carcinoma derived cells in response to radiation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the variant of MRPS28 gene (kDec03) is differentially expressed after radiation treatment.
the study shows that a splice variant of MRPS28 is differentially expressed and may be involved in radiation induced apoptosis.
the variant of MRPS28 gene (kDec03) is differentially expressed and up-regulated in response to radiation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the study demonstrates that the splice variant of the mitochondrial ribosomal protein S28 is differentially expressed after radiation in cervical carcinoma cells.
the variant kDec03 is expressed in SiHa cells, but not in the normal cells, is upregulated in response to irradiation in SiHa cells and is downregulated in normal cells.

a variant of the MRPs28 gene, kDec03, which is expressed in response to ionizing radiation, is a novel gene that may be important in radiation response in cervical carcinoma cells.
the splice variant of MRPS28 gene can serve as a biomarker for radiation induced changes in gene expression in cervical carcinoma derived cell lines.
the splice variant of MRPS28 is differentially expressed following radiation treatment in cervical carcinoma derived SiHa cells.
